note: Small prairie provincial-park campground near the east end of Little Fish Lake, about 43 km east of Drumheller off Hwy 851, run with the Special Areas Board: sites among planted trees, with a day-use area, hand boat launch and short walking trails through native grassland. No firewood is available; bring or buy it locally. --Claude
